<autocedar_condition_packet id="condition.0002.step0001">
Requirement to encode:
[source_id: src.root.p0002.l3; section: root] A user may merge a pull request only if the user holds the maintainer role, is not the pull request’s author, and is using the VPN.

Write one condition atom for each scope below. AutoCedar joins the conditions of a slice with AND and the slices of a scope with OR, so encode only what this requirement says.

Scope scope.mergePullRequest.User.PullRequest: principal User, action mergePullRequest, resource PullRequest (every way to allow it is listed).
  It is a condition of slice slice.mergePullRequest.User.PullRequest.1: User holds maintainer role, is not author of the pull request, uses VPN, pull request has approval and target branch starts with 'hotfix/'.
  The other conditions of this slice (encoded separately):
    [source_id: src.root.p0003.l3; section: root] The pull request must have at least one approval, and its target branch name must begin with “hotfix/”.
  Approved condition atoms of this scope:
    - none yet

Rules for interpretation (apply them to every requirement):
  [source_id: src.root.p0004.l5; section: root] These are the only permissions: merging is allowed when all these requirements are met; otherwise it is denied, and no other actions are permitted.
</autocedar_condition_packet>
